# GIF encoder donor

Unmodified `gifenc@1.0.3` compiled ESM distribution from
https://github.com/mattdesl/gifenc under the included MIT license.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/gifenc/-/gifenc-1.0.3.tgz
Package SHA-256: `29470c10132cd66ecac3b4da025b57ab9ec35df6e40215947f22eb2f14a128d4`.
Unmodified `package/dist/gifenc.esm.js` as `index.mjs` SHA-256:
`217761244379253ba5815510d3048a4fb1f4c4dbe9fb51a5cfbfe26f34eec093`.
The `index.d.mts` is a Strumentini type declaration for the public API,
not donor code.

The GIF format uses palette quantization (maximum 128 colors per frame).
Consequently, photographic footage may have visible color banding.
